description: This file contains a Python module for parsing diff/patch files, including classes and functions for handling diff data structures and parsing logic.

classes.name: DiffFile
classes.description: Represents a single file in a diff, containing lines with information about added, deleted, or unchanged lines.

classes.name: DiffParser
classes.description: Parses a diff input into a collection of DiffFile objects, handling the parsing state and line processing.

methods.name: added_or_modified_line_numbers
methods.description: Returns a list of line numbers that are added or modified in the diff file.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes a DiffFile with a filename and an empty list of lines.

methods.name: add_new_line
methods.description: Adds a new line to the diff, indicating an addition.

methods.name: add_deleted_line
methods.description: Adds a deleted line to the diff.

methods.name: add_unchanged_line
methods.description: Adds an unchanged line to the diff.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes a DiffParser with a diff input iterable and parses it into diff files.

methods.name: _parse_into_diff_files
methods.description: Internal method that processes the diff input into a dictionary of DiffFile objects.
